llm.guidance: This skill is small and mostly consistent with its stated purpose, but check a few things before installing: (1) The SKILL.md command uses node -e but the metadata doesn't declare Node as a required binary — ensure your agent environment actually provides node or update the command. (2) Verify the API endpoint and vendor: the docs point to skillboss.co but the request goes to api.heybossai.com — confirm these domains are legitimate and expected for the provider. (3) Avoid embedding API keys on the command line (they can appear in process listings); prefer an Authorization header, reading the key from stdin, or other safer approaches. (4) Only provide a SkillBoss API key scoped and revocable for this use; refrain from reusing high-privilege keys. (5) Because this is instruction-only (no code), the main risk is data sent to the remote API — only proceed if you trust the service and are comfortable with images and prompts being transmitted to that endpoint.
